project.name: Orbit
project.pitch: Redefining social media, for learning: a live map of people (circles) and friendships (lines) grouped into interest-group bubbles; click a bubble to zoom into its room for text chat, voice and screen share.
project.scope: VandyHacks hackathon demo. Polished visuals + working happy path. Optimize for the demo, not scale or hardening.

stack.nextjs_warning: Breaking changes vs. training data. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing Next-specific code.
stack.styling: Tailwind v4 (@tailwindcss/turbopack), shadcn (base-ui primitives) in components/ui, tw-animate-css
stack.validation: zod v4 on every API route body (lib/schemas.ts)
stack.db: OCI Autonomous Database (Oracle 23ai) via oracledb Thin mode; in-memory fallback when ORACLE_* unset
stack.realtime: LiveKit Cloud (data messages, voice, screen share); SSE fallback (single process only)
stack.storage: OCI Object Storage (avatars, chat archives); process memory fallback
stack.hosting: Vercel project vandyhacks-project-momo; daily cron /api/cron/expire-groups (Hobby plan)
stack.auth: None. userId + deviceKey in localStorage; x-user-id/x-device-key headers checked against device_key_hash on writes

invariants: API routes that touch oracledb run on the Node runtime, never Edge.
lib/store/types.ts defines the Store interface; lib/store/memory.ts and lib/store/oracle.ts must both implement every change.
Schema changes go in db/schema.sql via PR, and scripts/migrate.ts --upgrade must cover existing databases. One person applies them to the shared DB.
Every write route validates its body with zod and checks the device key (lib/auth.ts).
State changes broadcast through lib/events.ts so every open map updates live.
The app must keep running with zero env vars (in-memory world, SSE, local media preview).
Map zoom keeps d3-zoom's default direction; scrolling up inside a room zooms back out to the map.
A user is in exactly one active room (users.current_group_id); group_members keeps every community they joined.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for bobbing, trembling and camera moves.
Never commit .env.local or any secret; never paste its contents into chat, PRs or these handoff files.

danger.why: Drops every table on the SHARED team database. Never run it unless the human explicitly confirms for this exact run.
Deletes and recreates seed-* users and seed groups on the shared DB. Ask the human first.
Several teammates and agents branch off main concurrently.
Contains the OCI private key and DB password.

design.current: Warm redesign: charcoal (dark) / cream (light) themes, bone text, clay accent, static paper-grain ambient layer, soft OKLCH map palette.
design.palette_source_of_truth: app/globals.css defines --hue-<key> per theme; lib/colors.ts HUES lists keys (sage, clay, slate, ochre, plum, teal, rose, olive) + neutral 'stone'. Render with hueVar(key) / interestColor(id) / identityColor(user); use lib/client/palette.ts useHueHex() when real hex is needed (canvas, SVG gradients).
design.palette_status: HUES/CSS-var palette is staged on branch `color`, not yet on main. main still has the NEON array and NeonParticles.
design.group_hues: lib/client/groupHues.ts assigns each bubble a hue from the full unfiltered layout so neighbors differ; every surface reads the bubble's hue from there. Purely visual, not stored.
design.stored_colors: DB color columns hold a swatch hex only for records; UI never renders them directly.
rules: No hardcoded hex in components; use theme tokens or hueVar().
Fonts: Inter (UI), Space Grotesk (headings, group names) via next/font.
design.history: neon → warm redesign (#4) → reverted (#6) → reapplied → restore-warm-redesign (#9) → reverted (#10). Design churn is the main source of merge conflicts; confirm direction with the human before large visual changes.
